description: Search Amazon for gaming gear on the user's marketplace. Returns PA-API products when configured, otherwise gaming-filtered search deep-link cards. ALWAYS pass marketplace + locale. OpenAPI: searchAmazon.

locale.description: User locale, e.g. en, sv, de, fr

marketplace.description: Amazon storefront domain or id for the end user, e.g. amazon.com, amazon.se, us, se. REQUIRED.

name: search_gifts
title: Search gaming gifts
